plan.notes: Source: 'BA/MPA Political Science & Public Admin 4+1 Program - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of History), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. 4+1 program: 108 undergraduate + 36 graduate hours. Graduate PA courses are sequenced alongside undergraduate courses; the catalog term labels are kept verbatim, including 'Summer I - Semester 9', 'Summer II - Semester 10', 'Fall - Semester 11', 'Spring - Semester 12', and 'Summer I - Semester 13'. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. The Spring Semester 8 slot 'Elective 0-2' is printed as 0-2 credits; the lower bound (0) is used per collection convention. CREDIT DISCREPANCY: the sequenced sum is 143 credits (14/16/15/16/15/15/15/13/3/3/6/6/6) but the catalog prints 'Total hours required for major - 144'. The sequenced sum is kept as total_credits. extended:true — BA/MPA 4+1 program: 13 sequenced terms (108 undergrad + 36 graduate hours), per official plan.
